unresolved.details: Selected portions of Star Wars Tales #16, #17, #23, #24, Dark Horse Comics #7–9 and Star Wars Visionaries require story-level mapping; an issue mention does not assert that all its content belongs in scope.

unresolved.subject: Dark Lords of the Sith special ashcan edition numbering and page count
unresolved.details: One reading order calls it #0, while the wiki labels it an ashcan and Rebelscum identifies a 16-page edition with a 12-page preview. Another bibliography reports 20 pages; distinguish total pages, contents, indicia, variants and exact issue #1 correspondence by inspecting copies.

unresolved.subject: Dark Horse Insider volume 2 issue #20 date and preview fidelity
unresolved.details: One bibliography dates #20 August 1993 while Grand Comics Database lists July 1993. Check physical copies, indicia and exact preview lettering, color, captions and page mappings across #15–20; do not count partial previews as independent complete stories.

unresolved.subject: 1993 Nomi preview installments and 1994 Droids anthology issue numbering
unresolved.details: A 1993-94 contemporaneous checklist identifies the later Droids serial as Dark Horse Comics #17–19; a later checklist labels similar 1994 entries #7–9. Reconcile indicia, volumes and source dates before merging. Nomi artwork, lettering, captions and page relationships to the later Tales of the Jedi #3 also require direct comparison.

unresolved.subject: Dark Horse International UK Star Wars #7–10 story identity and issue #10 date
unresolved.details: Contemporary and retailer checklists report Tales of the Jedi content in #7–10, but exact mapping to the Nomi and Ulic narratives and page fidelity are not established. Sources differ on the series end date; #7 copies with or without a badge are not proven to be distinct printings. Inspect actual issues and indicia.
